title: Unit – 2 : Session – 9 : SLO – 2 | Method Overloading
sections: public int add(INT a, INT b) { return a + b; }
public int add(int a, int b, INT C) { return a + b + c; }
public double add(double a, double b) { return A + B; }
Each call resolves at compile time by matching the number and types of arguments — compile-time polymorphism (overloading).
